messages.en:
{07 05 00}Can we do this later?{01 00 00 14 00} I'm
sorry, but I really need a
second alone.
Nothing personal, but{01 00 00 05 00} I'm
about to explode! You don't
wanna be around for that.
messages.et:
{07 05 00}Kas teeme seda hiljem?{01 00 00 14 00} Mul
on kahju, aga ma vajan
tõesti hetke üksi.
Pole isiklik, aga{01 00 00 05 00} ma olen
plahvatamas! Sa ei taha
selle juures olla.

messages.en:
{07 01 00}I'm telling you that you 
want to stay away from me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
I don't want to gnaw your
ankle,{01 00 00 05 00} but at this rate,
I just might, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 01 00}Ma ütlen sulle, et sa
tahad minust eemale hoida,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
Ma ei taha su pahkluud
närida,{01 00 00 05 00} aga sellise tempoga
võin küll, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 05 00}Shut up!{01 00 00 14 00} I'm in a really,{01 00 00 05 00}
really bad mood right now!
messages.et:
{07 05 00}Jää vait!{01 00 00 14 00} Mul on praegu
tõesti,{01 00 00 05 00} tõesti halb tuju!
